verses.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ יַֽעַנְךָ֣ יְ֭הוָה בְּי֣וֹם צָרָ֑ה יְ֝שַׂגֶּבְךָ֗ שֵׁ֤ם׀ אֱלֹהֵ֬י יַעֲקֹֽב׃
verses.transliteration: lam·naṣ·ṣê·aḥ miz·mō·wr lə·ḏā·wiḏ ya·‘an·ḵā Yah·weh bə·yō·wm ṣā·rāh yə·śag·geḇ·ḵā šêm ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ
verses.literal: For the choirmaster A Psalm of David May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble may the name of the God of Jacob protect you
verses.literalPt: Responda-te Jeová no dia da tribulação; ponha-te num lugar alto o nome do Deus de Jacó.

verses.literal: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion
verses.literalPt: Envie-te do santuário auxílio e te sustenha de Sião.

verses.original: יִזְכֹּ֥ר כָּל־ מִנְחֹתֶ֑ךָ וְעוֹלָתְךָ֖ יְדַשְּׁנֶ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·kōr kāl- min·ḥō·ṯe·ḵā wə·‘ō·w·lā·ṯə·ḵā yə·ḏaš·šə·neh se·lāh
verses.literal: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings Selah
verses.literalPt: Lembre-se de todas as tuas ofertas de cereais e aceite os teus holocaustos. (Selá)

verses.original: יִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֥ כִלְבָבֶ֑ךָ וְֽכָל־ עֲצָתְךָ֥ יְמַלֵּֽא׃
verses.literal: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed
verses.literalPt: Conceda-te segundo o teu coração e cumpra todo o teu conselho.

verses.original: נְרַנְּנָ֤ה׀ בִּ֘ישׁ֤וּעָתֶ֗ךָ וּבְשֵֽׁם־ אֱלֹהֵ֥ינוּ נִדְגֹּ֑ל יְמַלֵּ֥א יְ֝הוָ֗ה כָּל־ מִשְׁאֲלוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: nə·ran·nə·nāh bî·šū·‘ā·ṯe·ḵā ū·ḇə·šêm- ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū niḏ·gōl yə·mal·lê Yah·weh kāl- miš·’ă·lō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God May the LORD grant all your petitions
verses.literalPt: Folgaremos de júbilo por tua salvação e, em nome de nosso Deus, arvoraremos pendões; cumpra Jeová todas as tuas petições.

verses.original: עַתָּ֤ה יָדַ֗עְתִּי כִּ֤י הוֹשִׁ֥יעַ׀ יְהוָ֗ה מְשִׁ֫יח֥וֹ יַ֭עֲנֵהוּ מִשְּׁמֵ֣י קָדְשׁ֑וֹ בִּ֝גְבֻר֗וֹת יֵ֣שַׁע יְמִינֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh yā·ḏa‘·tî kî hō·wō·šî·a‘ Yah·weh mə·šî·ḥōw ya·‘ă·nê·hū miš·šə·mê qā·ḏə·šōw biḡ·ḇu·rō·wṯ yê·ša‘ yə·mî·nōw
verses.literal: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand
verses.literalPt: Agora, sei eu que Jeová salva ao seu ungido; ele lhe responderá lá do seu santo céu com a força salvadora da sua destra.

verses.original: אֵ֣לֶּה בָ֭רֶכֶב וְאֵ֣לֶּה בַסּוּסִ֑ים וַאֲנַ֓חְנוּ׀ בְּשֵׁם־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣ינוּ נַזְכִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl·leh ḇā·re·ḵeḇ wə·’êl·leh ḇas·sū·sîm wa·’ă·naḥ·nū bə·šêm- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū naz·kîr
verses.literal: Some trust in chariots and others in horses but we trust in the name of the LORD our God
verses.literalPt: Uns confiam em carros, outros, em cavalos; nós, porém, faremos menção do nome de Jeová, nosso Deus.

verses.original: הֵ֭מָּה כָּרְע֣וּ וְנָפָ֑לוּ וַאֲנַ֥חְנוּ קַּ֝֗מְנוּ וַנִּתְעוֹדָֽד׃
verses.transliteration: hêm·māh kā·rə·‘ū wə·nā·p̄ā·lū wa·’ă·naḥ·nū qam·nū wan·niṯ·‘ō·w·ḏāḏ
verses.literal: They collapse and fall but we rise up and stand firm
verses.literalPt: Eles se acurvam e caem, mas nós nos erguemos e ficamos em pé.

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה הוֹשִׁ֑יעָה הַ֝מֶּ֗לֶךְ יַעֲנֵ֥נוּ בְיוֹם־ קָרְאֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh hō·wō·šî·‘āh ham·me·leḵ ya·‘ă·nê·nū ḇə·yō·wm- qā·rə·’ê·nū
verses.literal: O LORD save the king Answer us on the day we call
verses.literalPt: Salva, Jeová; responda-nos o rei no dia em que clamarmos.
